供水开户、停用或迁移入口；网上流程适用于独立住宅，多户住宅请联系客服。: Start, stop, or transfer water service here. The online process is for single-family homes; contact customer service for multifamily properties.
市营电力；搬家开户和停用直接联系 AMP，不使用 PG&E 电力开户。: Municipal electricity: contact AMP directly to start or stop service when moving, rather than opening a PG&E electricity account.
市政府列明的住宅垃圾服务联系入口；开户时确认回收、厨余和垃圾桶安排。: The city's listed contact for residential waste service. Confirm recycling, organics, and trash containers when opening an account.
租房先问房东或物业：水费、垃圾费可能由楼宇统一开户，再通过租金或账单分摊。: If you rent, ask the landlord or property manager first: water and waste service may be held in a building account and charged through rent or a separate bill.
负责 PG&E 服务地址的电力配送、开户及搬家通断电；发电供应商另见下项。: Handles electricity delivery and starting, stopping, or transferring service at PG&E addresses; see the next entry for generation service.
社区选择能源（CCA）发电服务；PG&E 继续配送和出账单。开户时按地址及账户确: Community Choice Aggregation (CCA) electricity generation; PG&E continues delivery and billing. Confirm the generation plan for your address and account; contact PG&E to turn service on or off when moving.
垃圾和厨余服务；市官网有住宅开户或服务变更入口。: Trash and compost service; the city page provides residential account and service-change instructions.
负责 1–4 户住宅的路边回收；较大公寓楼按物业及市政府多户住宅流程办理。: Handles curbside recycling for properties with 1–4 units; larger apartment buildings should follow property-management and city multifamily procedures.
列出多家机构表示服务区或职责不同，并非每个地址都可任选。: Multiple providers indicate different service areas or responsibilities; they are not necessarily choices available at every address.
网上申请新水账户；停用联系客服。先核实地址属于 DSRSD 供水区。: Apply online for a new water account; contact customer service to stop service. First confirm that the address is in DSRSD's water service area.
供水服务覆盖 Fremont、Newark、Union City；使用官方开户／: Water service covers Fremont, Newark, and Union City. Use the official start/stop page to confirm your address.
市官网的 Republic Services 链接用于开户、停用、漏收和垃圾桶问: Use the city's Republic Services link to start or stop collection, report missed pickups, or resolve cart issues.
服务市内多数地址；部分地址由 EBMUD 供水，开户前先核对。: Serves most city addresses; EBMUD serves some properties, so check before opening an account.
仅适用于该机构覆盖的地址；先查服务区或向客服报完整地址。: Only applies to addresses within this provider's service area. Check the service area or give customer service your full address.
垃圾开户统一先联系 WM；市官网另提示部分地址属于 Oro Loma 服务安排。: Contact WM first to start garbage service; the city also notes that some addresses fall under Oro Loma service arrangements.
住宅回收服务联系；新开垃圾账户仍先联系 WM。: Contact for residential recycling; start a new garbage account through WM.
先用市政府 Find My Provider 地图确认，再使用市营供水开户／停用: Check the city's Find My Provider map before using the municipal water start/stop form.
适用于 Cal Water 的 Livermore 服务区；选择对应供水区办理，: For addresses in Cal Water's Livermore service area: select the correct district and do not open a duplicate municipal water account.
负责垃圾、厨余和大件服务；通过开户页面或电话开始服务。: Handles trash, compost, and bulky-item service; start service through the signup page or by phone.
负责住宅回收；回收桶、漏收等问题联系 CWS。垃圾与厨余由 WM 负责。: Handles residential recycling; contact CWS about recycling carts or missed recycling pickups. WM handles trash and compost.
市政府供水开户、停用和账单入口；按住宅地址核对账户责任人。: City water account, start/stop, and billing information; confirm the account holder for the residential address.
垃圾服务分为 ACI 与 WM／Oro Loma 区域；用市官网服务区地图查地址: Waste service is divided between ACI and WM/Oro Loma areas. Check the city's service-area map by address; the mailing city does not give you a choice of hauler.
负责垃圾服务及直接账单；搬家开户、停用先联系 Republic Services: Handles garbage service and direct billing; contact Republic Services first to start or stop service when moving.
负责回收和厨余／园林垃圾桶服务；与 Republic 的垃圾服务分工不同。: Handles recycling and organics/yard-waste cart service, separately from Republic's garbage service.
市政府水账户开户入口；按业主或租客身份准备官网要求的材料。: City water account signup; prepare the documents listed for owners or tenants.
通过 PG&E 官方搬家入口核对地址并办理电力开户、停用或迁移。: Use PG&E's official moving page to check the address and start, stop, or transfer electricity service.
市政府 Utility Billing 办理水、污水及垃圾账户；开户前核实新址是: City Utility Billing handles water, sewer, and garbage accounts; confirm that the new address is within the municipal service area.
市营垃圾服务，开户和搬家通过市政府公用事业账单窗口办理。: Municipal garbage service; arrange signup or a move through the city's utility-billing office.
同城可能有不同服务区；先用完整街道地址及单元号确认，再办理开户。: Service areas may differ within a city. Confirm your full street address and unit number before opening an account.
供水零售账户通过官网所列电话办理开户或停用；先确认地址由 CCWD 直接出水费账: Use the phone number on the official page to open or close a retail water account. First confirm that CCWD bills your address directly.
负责垃圾和厨余／园林垃圾；开户、停用和垃圾桶变更直接联系公司。: Handles trash and organics/yard waste; contact the company to start or stop service or change carts.
负责市营回收服务；蓝色回收桶问题或回收漏收联系市政府。: Handles municipal recycling; contact the city about blue recycling carts or missed recycling pickups.
市内饮用水由 City of Martinez 或 CCWD 按区域提供；先凭地: Drinking water is supplied by the City of Martinez or CCWD depending on the area. Confirm the water-billing provider for your address first.
居民供水开户／停用表格入口；先按完整地址确认是否属于供水区。: Residential water start/stop forms; confirm that the full address is within the district's service area.
市政府供水开户／停用入口；租客办理时有业主签署或陪同等材料要求，出发前按官网确认: City water start/stop information. Tenants have owner-signature or attendance requirements; check the official instructions before visiting.
有 CCWD、EBMUD 和 City of Martinez 三个饮用水服务区: There are three drinking-water service areas: CCWD, EBMUD, and the City of Martinez. Check by address. Diablo Vista's untreated irrigation water is not a residential drinking-water account option.
市政府目录列 Richmond Sanitary Service；从该官方目录进: The city directory lists Richmond Sanitary Service. Follow its provider link and confirm signup contacts for your residential address.
供水分 EBMUD 与 DSRSD 区域；垃圾服务由 ACI San Ramon: Water service is split between EBMUD and DSRSD. Waste service is provided by ACI San Ramon; do not infer the hauler from the Contra Costa county name.
供水由 EBMUD 或 CCWD 分区负责；RecycleSmart 是垃圾项目: Water service is divided between EBMUD and CCWD. RecycleSmart administers the waste program; residents contact Republic Services to open collection accounts.
水与污水服务的开户／停用入口；与电力账户分别办理。: Start or stop water and sewer service here; the account is separate from electricity.
适用于 PG&E 配送地址；办理电力开户、停用和搬家。先向物业确认楼宇是否改由: For addresses with PG&E delivery: use it for electricity signup, shutoff, and moves. First ask the property manager whether the building is served by Hetch Hetchy Power.
PG&E 配送区域的社区选择发电服务；PG&E 仍负责账单、电线及搬家通断电。: Community-choice electricity generation in PG&E delivery areas; PG&E still handles billing, power lines, and turning service on or off when moving.
仅适用于已接入的楼宇或符合条件的开发项目；先向物业或 SFPUC 核对地址，不是: Only for connected buildings or eligible developments. Confirm the address with the property manager or SFPUC; it is not an electricity option every city resident can directly select.
按地址分区；不知道所属公司时可用此号码查询，再办理开户或停用。: Assigned by address. Call this number if you do not know your provider, then arrange signup or closure.
适用于该公司覆盖的地址；先查账单上的公司名或向 Recology 确认。: For addresses within this company's service area. Check the company name on the bill or confirm with Recology.
